children: Patrick Industries said it withdrew and then refiled its Hart-Scott-Rodino notification in connection with its agreed merger with LCI.
Patrick Industries and LCI entered a merger agreement calling for a two-step merger into Patrick subsidiaries.
Patrick filed an HSR premerger notification on Aug 5, then voluntarily withdrew and refiled on Sept 9, restarting the HSR waiting period.
Expiration or termination of the HSR waiting period is a closing condition; other conditions under the merger agreement also must be satisfied or waived.
